criteria.no: The item does not state the directive: it is silent about it, names only the topic, or describes a different approach.
criteria.unclear: The item states part of the directive's content but it cannot be determined whether it plans the directive itself.
criteria.yes: The item says the sanity or qa assignment runs as the phase lead read from .atm-bd/phase-<x>.toml, set on that assign call only.

addressed.instructions: `anchor.statement` requires that every `atm task assign` that the close hook or atm-bd issues for a sanity or qa bead runs as the phase lead named in .atm-bd/phase-<x>.toml, set on that one subprocess, while atm-bd's notices keep the sender atm-bd@tool. Does `item.text` state this directive's specific content as a step, constraint or decision? An item that only names the topic, or that runs the assignment or the notices under another identity, or takes the lead from the process environment, does not state it. Judge presence of the directive only, not whether the item conflicts with it.

criteria.no: Nothing in the item is one of the ruled-out cases, including when the item is silent about the directive.
criteria.unclear: The item is ambiguous enough that it might describe one of the ruled-out cases, but it cannot be determined.
criteria.yes: The item states a plan, approach or decision that is one of the ruled-out cases.

contradicted.instructions: Does `item.text` plan something that `anchor.statement` rules out? The anchor rules out: a sanity or qa `atm task assign` issued as anyone other than the phase lead, such as the dev or atm-bd@tool; taking the lead identity from the process environment instead of the phase file; setting the lead identity for the whole process instead of on the one assign subprocess; atm-bd notices sent under any sender other than atm-bd@tool. These are not a conflict: silence about identity; a dev's own status message sent as the dev. Judge conflict only.

criteria.no: The item is about a different part of the system or a different activity and does not touch which ATM identity runs `atm task assign` for sanity and qa beads in the close hook or atm-bd, and which sender atm-bd's notices use.
criteria.unclear: The item text is too vague to tell whether it touches the anchor's subject.
criteria.yes: The item assigns sanity or qa beads, chooses or sets the identity for `atm task assign`, or changes the sender of atm-bd's notices.

relevant.instructions: The state holds one planning item (`item.title`, `item.text`) and one anchor (`anchor.statement`, `anchor.scope`) about which ATM identity runs `atm task assign` for sanity and qa beads in the close hook or atm-bd, and which sender atm-bd's notices use. Does the work described in `item.text` plan, change, or depend on that subject? Judge overlap of subject matter only. Do not judge whether the item obeys the anchor.

anchor.statement: Every atm task assign that the close hook or atm-bd issues for a sanity or qa bead must run as the phase lead named in .atm-bd/phase-<x>.toml, set on that one subprocess, while every notice atm-bd sends keeps the constant sender atm-bd@tool.
anchor.scope: the sender of atm task assign in atm-task-close.py and in atm-bd dispatch; notices keep ANC-042

item.text: The console shows the sol icon next to every Codex agent of model sol in the agent list.
